text: Research team synthesized plant-based hydrogels capable of breaking down naturally in marine environments within months.

title: Bank of England publishes updated guidance on wholesale central bank digital currency pilots
text: Monetary authority outlined synchronized settlement trials between commercial banking reserves and tokenized assets.

title: World Food Programme expands emergency relief logistics in drought-affected Horn of Africa
text: Humanitarian logistics teams dispatched fortified grain shipments to assist vulnerable agrarian communities.

title: Archaeologists unearth 4000 year old fortified Bronze Age settlement in northwestern Arabia
text: Excavations revealed monumental stone walls, dwelling clusters, and agricultural terraces documented in archaeological journals.

title: Global health authorities endorse new oral cholera vaccine formulation with simplified manufacturing
text: WHO prequalification approval expands international vaccine stockpile availability for endemic transmission zones.

title: Pope Francis shocks world by endorsing presidential candidate in unprecedented move
text: Viral blog post claims Pope Francis released a statement explicitly endorsing a political candidate in the US election. The Vatican Press Office confirmed the Pope does not endorse political candidates.

title: NASA confirms planetary alignment next Tuesday will temporarily cancel Earth gravity for five minutes
text: Viral hoax attributed to British astronomer claims a rare conjunction of Pluto and Jupiter will weaken Earth gravitation. Gravitational physics and NASA confirm planetary alignment cannot reduce gravity.

title: Drinking boiled ginger and turmeric tea completely cures dengue virus and raises platelets instantly
text: Medical claims circulating on social media claim natural ginger brew cures acute hemorrhagic dengue within 24 hours. Hematologists confirm supportive hospital hydration and platelet monitoring are required.

title: Government introduces mandatory 18 percent tax on all digital UPI payments exceeding 1000 rupees
text: Viral rumor on messaging apps claimed the Ministry of Finance will charge 18% GST on every peer-to-peer UPI transfer. Finance Ministry clarified that regular merchant and individual UPI transactions remain completely tax-free.

title: Famous Hollywood actor Morgan Freeman found dead in his Los Angeles residence
text: Recurring celebrity death hoax circulated on social platforms using fabricated news agency screenshots. Representatives confirmed Morgan Freeman is alive and working on film projects.

title: World Health Organization confirms COVID-19 pandemic was an artificial computer simulation
text: Conspiracy blogs claim WHO director admitted the global pandemic was staged via computer modeling. Epidemiologists and official health records document millions of clinical hospitalizations and genomic sequencing.

title: Central government declares all educational degrees earned through online distance learning invalid
text: Fake notification with forged UGC logo claimed online university degrees will no longer be recognized for employment. UGC issued a public alert confirming recognized online degrees hold equal validity.

title: Secret hidden feature: dialing 112 with phone upside down activates military satellite defense
text: TikTok viral clip claiming inverted smartphone orientation unlocks military tracking. Telecom regulators clarified emergency services operate identically regardless of phone orientation.

title: Massive 9.8 magnitude earthquake predicted to strike Japan this Sunday per leaked government memo
text: Viral message attributes specific date and time earthquake prediction to meteorological authorities. Seismologists confirm earthquakes cannot be predicted with specific dates and times.

title: Eating bitter gourd and raw honey prevents snake venom from circulating in human bloodstream
text: Dangerous folk remedy circulating in rural communities claiming raw vegetables neutralize snake toxins. Anti-venom serum is the only medically validated treatment for envenomation.

title: WhatsApp adding fourth blue tick to indicate police have downloaded chat transcripts
text: Chain message claiming WhatsApp added 3rd and 4th checkmarks to signal government eavesdropping. WhatsApp confirms end-to-end encryption architecture has no multi-tick surveillance feature.

title: Major airline offers free lifetime flight passes to anyone who shares post with 50 friends
text: Social media phishing scam mimicking airline branding to collect email addresses and phone numbers. The airline confirmed no such promotion exists.

title: Scientists prove microwaves change molecular structure of water into toxic poison
text: Long-standing pseudoscientific claim that microwave radiation produces carcinogenic radiolytic compounds. Physics and food safety agencies confirm non-ionizing microwave radiation only heats water molecules safely.

title: New currency notes have hidden radio-frequency tracking barcodes readable from satellites
text: Viral post claimed high denomination fiat currency contains RFID tags monitored by space satellites. Central banks and printing presses confirmed currency only uses physical optical watermarks and intaglio ink.

title: United Nations passes resolution declaring vegetarianism mandatory across all member states by 2030
text: Satirical article repurposed as real news claiming UN mandates plant-based diets. UN sustainable development goals encourage sustainable agriculture but impose no dietary mandates.

title: Charging smartphone overnight causes battery chemicals to leak and release toxic gas into bedrooms
text: Sensationalized claims about modern lithium-ion batteries. Electronic engineering standards confirm smart IC power management circuits terminate charging automatically once 100% capacity is reached.

title: Drinking black tea with crushed aspirin eliminates diabetes symptoms within 48 hours
text: Viral TikTok health trend claiming common headache medicine cures hyperglycemia. Endocrinologists warn aspirin can cause gastric bleeding and does not stimulate pancreatic insulin secretion.

title: Billionaire tech mogul donates 90 percent of corporate profits directly to followers who comment
text: Engagement-farming social media bots using deepfake footage to trick users into subscribing to shady financial telegram groups.

title: Ancient Mayan pyramid discovered in Antarctica beneath 2 miles of glacial ice
text: Clickbait conspiracy theory claiming satellite photos reveal human pyramids in the South Pole. Polar geologists confirmed the formations are natural nunatak mountain peaks protruding through ice.

title: Ministry of Railways gives 100 percent concession on train tickets for all senior citizens permanently
text: Fake news reports claimed complete fare waivers for senior citizens had been reinstated across all classes. Railway authorities clarified concession policies remain unchanged.

title: Placing copper coins on burns draws out heat and prevents blisters from forming
text: Home remedy myth that can introduce serious bacterial contamination to damaged skin tissue. Emergency burn care guidelines advise clean cool running water.

title: International Cricket Council strips tournament victory after investigating illegal ball tampering
text: Fabricated social media headline alleging a World Cup final match was overturned due to ball tampering. ICC records confirm match results and player integrity reports stand official.

title: Drinking silver nanoparticles creates natural electromagnetic shield against 5G radio waves
text: Unregulated wellness product advertisement claiming metallic liquid protects against telecommunications frequencies. Health agencies caution heavy metal ingestion causes neurological and kidney damage.

title: Government to track bank accounts and freeze funds if social media posts criticize state policy
text: Alarmist viral messages misinterpreting routine financial compliance guidelines. Banking laws protect customer funds under statutory regulatory frameworks.

title: NASA Hubble telescope captures image of giant floating golden gate in deep space
text: Manipulated photographic artwork presented as astronomical discovery. NASA archives confirm image is digital CGI art with no scientific origin.

title: Eating five almonds every morning guarantees immunity against seasonal influenza and common cold
text: Nutritional over-exaggeration. While almonds contain vitamin E and healthy fats, infectious disease specialists clarify no single food provides absolute viral immunity.

title: Government distributing free laptops to all ration card holders through unverified web link
text: Phishing scam URL designed to harvest Aadhaar and mobile OTP credentials. Ministry of Electronics issued alert debunking the fraudulent link.

title: Astronomers confirm sun will flip magnetic poles causing 72 hours of total global darkness next month
text: Solar magnetic field reversals occur approximately every 11 years at solar maximum without interrupting solar irradiance or causing planetary darkness.

title: World health regulators ban white rice consumption due to lethal levels of synthetic plastic
text: Debunked food safety rumor. Food standards and safety authorities conduct nationwide surveillance testing and confirm rice grain integrity across retail channels.

title: Leaked audio reveals central bank governor plotting to confiscate private gold jewelry
text: Fabricated audio track synthesized with AI tools. Financial authorities and treasury officials confirmed gold holding regulations remain strictly governed by existing taxation laws.

title: Eating boiled eggs alongside watermelon produces fatal chemical reaction in human stomach
text: Nutritional myth circulated on messaging groups. Gastroenterologists confirm protein and water-rich fruit digest normally through gastric acids without generating toxic compounds.

title: Space agency detects radio transmission from intelligent alien probe approaching Saturn
text: Tabloid sensationalism misrepresenting natural radio emissions generated by Saturn auroral plasma waves recorded by the Cassini spacecraft.

title: New AI software can predict your exact lifespan from a photo of your palm lines
text: Astrology palmistry mobile apps marketing automated lifespan claims. Clinical epidemiology confirms longevity is governed by genetics, lifestyle, and medical access, not hand creases.

title: Postal department announces automatic cash refunds for delayed parcel deliveries above 2 days
text: Viral claims asserting universal cash compensations. Postal service terms specify express priority guarantees apply only to specific registered services under declared service conditions.

title: Drinking seawater in small sips prevents dehydration during desert emergencies
text: Extremely dangerous medical misconception. High osmotic salinity of seawater forces human kidneys to excrete more water than consumed, accelerating lethal dehydration.

title: Supreme Court rules all traffic fines issued by automated speed cameras are illegal
text: Misleading claims regarding speed detection. Judicial rulings have upheld electronic traffic enforcement provided calibration and photographic evidence standards are met.

title: Secret volcanic eruption beneath Bermuda Triangle responsible for centuries of lost ships
text: Mythological folklore. Maritime safety data and NOAA oceanographic surveys confirm navigational incidents in the Bermuda Triangle do not statistically exceed other heavily trafficked shipping lanes.

title: Government mandates all citizens must download commercial shopping app for identity verification
text: Malware distribution campaign impersonating official e-governance initiatives. Cyber security agencies issued public advisories warning against sideloading third-party APKs.

title: Drinking pure vinegar dissolves gallstones within 24 hours without surgical intervention
text: Alternative medicine claim without clinical backing. Gallstones reside in the gallbladder and do not come into direct contact with consumed oral liquids.

title: Celebrity tech billionaire secretly buys entire Pacific island nation to build sovereign AI city
text: Satirical speculative news report taken out of context. Island state governments confirmed national sovereignty and constitutional integrity remain undisturbed.

title: United Nations Climate Summit concludes with landmark agreement on global carbon market standards
text: Delegates from nearly 200 nations finalized operational guidelines under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement to facilitate international carbon credit transfers and emissions reduction monitoring.

title: Federal Reserve maintains federal funds rate while highlighting progress toward inflation targets
text: The Federal Open Market Committee voted to hold benchmark interest rates steady, noting balanced labor market conditions and steady GDP expansion across major economic sectors.

title: James Webb Space Telescope detects water vapor in terrestrial planet forming zone of young star system
text: Astronomers using MIRI infrared spectrometer identified abundant steam inside the protoplanetary disk of star PDS 70, offering clues to volatile delivery during rocky planet formation.

title: World Health Organization prequalifies affordable novel oral cholera vaccine to ease global stockpile shortage
text: WHO approved simplified formulation vaccine Euvichol-S produced with streamlined manufacturing methods to boost emergency outbreak response in vulnerable humanitarian regions.

title: Reserve Bank of India expands bilateral local currency settlement framework with central banks
text: RBI signed operational agreements enabling cross-border financial transactions denominated directly in domestic currencies, reducing dependence on third-country intermediary clearing systems.

title: NASA Europa Clipper spacecraft completes successful launch on six year voyage to explore Jovian ocean moon
text: The SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket launched NASA flagship mission to investigate whether habitable environments exist beneath Europa outer ice shell.

title: European Central Bank lowers key policy rates as Eurozone headline inflation moderates toward target
text: Governing Council of the ECB reduced deposit facility rates following data showing cooling wage growth and stabilized energy import prices.

title: International Monetary Fund upgrades global economic growth forecast driven by resilient consumer spending
text: The IMF World Economic Outlook projected global output expansion supported by resilient private consumption, technology investments, and trade rebound across emerging economies.

title: Indian Space Research Organisation successfully tests semi-cryogenic engine pre-burner for heavy lift launch vehicle
text: ISRO propulsion complex validated hot test performance of the 2000 kN thrust semi-cryogenic engine designed to enhance payload delivery capacity for future orbital missions.

title: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded for pioneering foundational discoveries enabling machine learning with artificial neural networks
text: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences honored John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for developing statistical physics methods that underpin modern deep neural network architectures.

title: Department of Telecommunications blocks over 1 crore fraudulent mobile SIM connections linked to cyber fraud
text: Telecom authorities in collaboration with police cyber cells deactivated unauthorized connections identified via automated AI facial analysis and forged identity documents.

title: World Trade Organization panel issues ruling on agricultural tariff disputes and export subsidy notifications
text: Dispute settlement body adopted panel findings addressing domestic support notifications and trade commitments under WTO multilateral agreements.

title: CERN Large Hadron Collider observes rare decay of neutral B meson providing precision tests of Standard Model physics
text: LHCb collaboration physicists reported high-statistics measurements of rare particle decays matching theoretical Standard Model predictions with five-sigma significance.

title: Ministry of Road Transport mandates electronic stability control and advanced braking systems for heavy commercial vehicles
text: Transport safety notification sets mandatory compliance timelines requiring automated safety assist technologies to reduce highway collision frequencies.

title: World Bank approves financing package to modernize rural water infrastructure and drought resilience
text: Multilateral development lenders sanctioned funding for pipe rehabilitation, groundwater recharge basins, and community management programs in arid farming districts.

title: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention issues updated guidelines on annual respiratory virus immunizations
text: CDC advisory committee recommended updated seasonal formulations targeting dominant circulating influenza and RSV variants for vulnerable demographics.

title: Indian Railways deploys Kavach automatic train protection system across high-density trunk routes
text: Safety directorate expanded installation of indigenous RFID and radio-frequency collision prevention systems across major passenger and freight corridors.

title: Stock exchanges introduce T plus zero same day trade settlement cycle for select equity securities
text: Capital market regulators initiated optional same-day clearing mechanisms to accelerate fund transfers and enhance investor capital liquidity.

title: Global renewable energy investments surpass fossil fuel spending according to International Energy Agency analysis
text: IEA World Energy Investment report highlighted accelerated capital deployment into solar utility farms, grid battery storage, and electric mobility infrastructure.

title: Archaeologists discover prehistoric cave paintings depicting wildlife migrations in southern Spain
text: Peer-reviewed study in archaeological journal dated charcoal pigments back over 20,000 years, providing insight into Upper Paleolithic hunting culture.

title: Government of India launches national clean air program tracking particulate matter reductions in non-attainment cities
text: Central Pollution Control Board recorded measurable decreases in PM10 and PM2.5 concentrations following dust suppression and industrial boiler modernizations.

title: SpaceX and NASA conclude Crew 8 rotation mission with safe ocean splashdown off Florida coast
text: Dragon spacecraft completed autonomous re-entry and parachute deceleration following a 235-day science expedition aboard the International Space Station.

title: Bank for International Settlements completes multinational digital currency cross-border payment project Agorá
text: Central banks from seven monetary jurisdictions tested tokenized commercial bank deposits integrated with unified programmable ledger architectures.

title: Health ministry alerts hospitals to maintain surveillance for seasonal avian influenza strains in migratory flyways
text: Veterinary and epidemiological surveillance teams intensified wildlife sampling near wetland sanctuaries to monitor potential zoonotic spillover markers.

title: Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission expands tsunami early warning deep-sea buoys across Indian Ocean
text: UNESCO ocean network operationalized next-generation bottom pressure recorders capable of detecting millimeter-scale sea surface displacement.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs cracks down on deceptive dark patterns in e-commerce flight and hotel booking portals
text: Guidelines prohibit drip pricing, forced action checkouts, disguised advertisements, and false urgency timers across digital retail marketplaces.

title: Oxford-AstraZeneca developer initiates clinical trials for multi-strain nasal spray respiratory vaccine
text: Phase 2 clinical trial evaluates mucosal antibody production in respiratory linings to provide sterilizing immunity against airborne pathogens.

title: Supreme Court upholds constitutional validity of automated digital property tax assessments with right to audit
text: Judicial bench ruled municipal algorithmic tax mapping complies with due process when accompanied by dispute redressal and verification safeguards.

title: National Remote Sensing Centre publishes high-resolution satellite atlas mapping Himalayan glacial lakes
text: ISRO earth observation division mapped over 28,000 glacial water bodies to identify vulnerable basins susceptible to glacial lake outburst floods.

title: International Telecommunication Union adopts global radio spectrum allocations for next generation 6G mobile research
text: World Radiocommunication Conference harmonized frequency bands between 7 and 24 GHz to support high-throughput mobile connectivity innovations.

title: World Food Programme ships 200000 tons of fortified wheat grain to communities recovering from cyclone flooding
text: United Nations humanitarian logistics corridors distributed emergency food rations through verified community ration centers.

title: Ministry of Power announces power grid integration of 200 gigawatts of non-fossil renewable capacity
text: National load dispatch center reported continuous grid stability with record daily green electricity integration shares exceeding 40 percent.

title: Astronomers at ESO Very Large Telescope capture unprecedented direct images of exoplanet orbiting nearby young star
text: Infrared coronagraph instrument filtered stellar glare to document thermal glow from gas giant protoplanet in stellar formation nursery.

title: Cyber security emergency response team issues security best practices for safeguarding smart home IoT appliances
text: CERT advisory urged consumer firmware updates, default credential changes, and guest network isolation to mitigate automated botnet recruitment.

title: Finance Ministry notifies simplified income tax refund processing timelines using automated straight-through systems
text: Direct tax administration reported automated refund dispatch for over 85 percent of verified individual returns within 10 days of filing.

title: Global alliance of polar scientists confirms ozone layer recovery continues on track toward 1980 levels
text: WMO and UNEP scientific assessment panel confirmed Montreal Protocol phase-out of chlorofluorocarbons has enabled continuous stratospheric ozone healing.

title: National Highways Authority implements multi-lane free flow tolling using automated license plate recognition cameras
text: Pilot deployment on expressways eliminates physical toll barriers, scanning high-speed vehicle transponders to reduce congestion and carbon emissions.

title: International Energy Agency reports global electric car sales represented 1 in 5 vehicles sold worldwide
text: Global EV Outlook tracked expanding battery manufacturing capacity and falling battery cell prices driving consumer adoption across key markets.

title: World Health Organization declares elimination of maternal and neonatal tetanus in several developing nations
text: Sustained immunization campaigns and clean delivery health center investments verified complete interruption of neonatal infection transmission.

title: Geological Survey of India maps prospective lithium and critical rare earth mineral reserves across peninsular blocks
text: Exploration reports identified non-ferrous mineralized pegmatites to support domestic energy transition and battery manufacturing supply chains.

title: WHO and UNICEF announce rollout of second malaria vaccine R21 to children in African countries
text: The World Health Organization and UNICEF have begun nationwide distribution of the R21 Matrix-M malaria vaccine across high-transmission regions in Central and West Africa. Clinical trials involving thousands of infants demonstrated 77 percent efficacy in preventing clinical malaria over 12 months. The low-cost vaccine manufactured by the Serum Institute of India complements the existing RTS,S vaccine to address long-standing global supply bottlenecks.

title: Reserve Bank of India keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.5 percent to anchor retail inflation
text: The Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee voted by a majority to maintain the benchmark policy repo rate at 6.5 percent following its bi-monthly review. Governor Shaktikanta Das noted that while core inflation has steadily moderated toward the 4 percent target, recurring vegetable and food price shocks warrant a continued withdrawal of accommodation stance to ensure macroeconomic price stability.

title: James Webb Space Telescope detects methane and carbon dioxide in atmosphere of ocean exoplanet K2-18b
text: Astrophysicists analyzing transmission spectroscopy data from the James Webb Space Telescope NIRSpec instrument confirmed significant detections of carbon-bearing molecules, including methane and carbon dioxide, in the atmosphere of sub-Neptune exoplanet K2-18b. The scarcity of ammonia suggests the presence of a deep liquid water ocean beneath a hydrogen-rich atmosphere 120 light-years away in the constellation Leo.

title: European Union formally adopts comprehensive AI Act to regulate high-risk artificial intelligence models
text: The European Parliament and member state ministers gave final approval to the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act. The landmark regulation introduces tiered obligations: outright bans on biometric surveillance that violates fundamental rights, strict transparency and copyright audits for general-purpose foundation models, and mandatory watermarking of AI-generated audiovisual content.

title: ISRO successfully launches Chandrayaan-3 propulsion module test returning payload to Earth orbit
text: The Indian Space Research Organisation achieved a major technological milestone by successfully executing a trajectory maneuver that brought the Chandrayaan-3 propulsion module from lunar orbit back into high Earth orbit. The experiment verified automated re-entry navigation and gravity-assist propulsion algorithms required for future planned lunar sample return missions.

title: Federal Reserve reports US banking sector remains resilient with strong capital and liquidity buffers
text: The Federal Reserve released its comprehensive Financial Stability Report, concluding that the domestic banking sector remains sound with regulatory capital ratios well above statutory requirements. The report noted that while commercial real estate asset valuations face ongoing pressure from hybrid work patterns, banks maintain adequate loan loss provisions.

title: International Energy Agency confirms global solar capacity additions surged by 85 percent year over year
text: The International Energy Agency published its annual Renewable Energy Market Update, reporting that global solar photovoltaic installations expanded at a record pace, driven by rapid utility-scale grid additions across China, Europe, and India. The report estimated that renewables will surpass coal as the largest primary source of global electricity generation within three years.

title: Department of Telecommunications deactivates over 1.4 crore fake SIM cards using AI portal ASTR
text: The Department of Telecommunications revealed that telecom security enforcement cells have severed over 14 million unauthorized mobile connections detected through the indigenous AI-powered facial analytics tool ASTR. The automated system flags mass SIM registrations generated under identical photographs paired with disparate forged identity documents.

title: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine awarded for nucleoside base modifications that enabled mRNA COVID vaccines
text: The Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine jointly to Katalin Kariko and Drew Weissman for their foundational discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications. Their biochemical research eliminated harmful inflammatory responses, enabling the rapid development of effective mRNA vaccines during the global pandemic.

title: National Highways Authority of India transitions national expressways to barrierless GNSS tolling
text: The National Highways Authority of India initiated pilot runs for Global Navigation Satellite System GNSS-based electronic toll collection. The satellite tracking system computes toll charges based on exact distance traversed along highway corridors, eliminating physical toll plaza bottlenecks and idling vehicle exhaust emissions.

title: World Meteorological Organization confirms past decade was the warmest on instrumental record
text: The World Meteorological Organization published its State of the Global Climate report, confirming that greenhouse gas concentrations, ocean heat content, and surface temperatures reached record anomalies. The synthesis of six international temperature datasets documented that every decade since the 1980s has been warmer than the previous one.

title: Ministry of Finance reports gross GST collections reached record 1.87 lakh crore rupees
text: Official fiscal data released by the Department of Revenue showed gross Goods and Services Tax revenue collections touched an all-time peak of 1.87 lakh crore rupees, reflecting a 12 percent year-on-year growth. The buoyancy was driven by strong domestic manufacturing consumption, improved tax compliance, and automated electronic invoicing.

title: SpaceX Falcon Heavy successfully launches NASA Psyche mission on 2.2 billion mile voyage to metal asteroid
text: NASA Psyche spacecraft successfully lifted off from Kennedy Space Center atop a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket. The six-year mission will travel to the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter to orbit asteroid 16 Psyche, offering unprecedented insight into planetary core formation and the building blocks of rocky terrestrial planets.

title: Supreme Court of India rules electoral bonds scheme unconstitutional for violating freedom of information
text: A five-judge Constitution bench of the Supreme Court of India unanimously struck down the Electoral Bonds scheme, ruling that anonymous corporate donations to political parties violate Article 19 1 a of the Constitution. The apex court directed the State Bank of India to submit complete transaction records to the Election Commission for public disclosure.

title: Oxford University researchers develop low-cost blood test for early detection of multiple cancers
text: A multi-institutional oncology team led by Oxford University scientists published clinical validation results in the journal Lancet Oncology for a liquid biopsy assay capable of identifying early-stage tumor DNA fragments across 12 solid cancer types with 82 percent sensitivity and 99 percent specificity.

title: NASA announces Earth will enter three days of complete darkness due to giant cosmic dust cloud
text: A viral message forwarded across WhatsApp and social media claims NASA Administrator issued an emergency announcement stating that on December 21, the Earth will enter a total solar blackout for 72 hours as our solar system traverses an interstellar dust cloud. NASA planetary scientists confirmed the claim is a recurring hoax and that no cosmic cloud capable of blocking solar radiation exists.

title: Boiling raw lemons and drinking warm baking soda water completely destroys all cancer cells in 48 hours
text: Viral health blogs claim that a simple kitchen remedy consisting of hot lemon slices mixed with sodium bicarbonate is 10,000 times more potent than chemotherapy and cures stage 4 malignant tumors within two days without side effects. Leading oncology associations and medical researchers confirm the claim is completely fraudulent and dangerous to cancer patients who delay hospital treatments.

title: Reserve Bank of India to ban all 500 rupee notes and introduce 1000 rupee notes with microchip
text: Rumors spreading rapidly on social media state that the Reserve Bank of India has decided to withdraw all 500 denomination currency notes from circulation by the end of next month, replacing them with a new 1000 rupee note containing a GPS microchip. The RBI officially clarified that 500 currency notes remain legal tender and no GPS-embedded currency notes exist.

title: Government of India giving free 50000 rupees to all citizens who register on unverified scholarship link
text: A viral message accompanied by a shortened link claims the Central Government has launched the PM Kanya or Youth Cash Distribution Scheme offering immediate 50,000 rupee direct bank transfers to every family. PIB Fact Check confirmed no such cash grant scheme exists and that the phishing website is designed to steal banking OTPs and personal credentials.

title: Typing your ATM PIN backwards immediately alerts police and traps thief inside ATM booth
text: Social media posts claim that entering your bank card PIN in reverse order e.g. 4321 instead of 1234 will silently notify local police headquarters while dispensing cash to protect the victim during armed robberies. Banking security engineers and law enforcement confirm ATM terminals possess no reverse PIN emergency dispatch functionality.

title: Drinking 100 percent pure colloidal silver makes human body immune to all viral and bacterial infections
text: Alternative wellness channels claim daily consumption of dissolved microscopic silver particles creates an impermeable electromagnetic shield against viruses and renders antibiotics obsolete. The FDA and health ministries warn that colloidal silver has no proven medical benefits and causes irreversible argyria skin discoloration and permanent organ damage.

title: WhatsApp introduces fourth blue tick to signal local police have downloaded your private chats
text: Chain letters circulating online claim WhatsApp implemented a system of checkmarks where one tick means sent, two mean delivered, three blue mean read, and four red ticks mean police have seized chat logs. WhatsApp confirmed that its end-to-end Signal protocol encryption prevents any party including WhatsApp itself from downloading or viewing chat transcripts.

title: UNESCO officially votes national anthem of India as the best national anthem in the whole world
text: A long-running viral chain hoax resurfaces periodically claiming UNESCO announced the Indian national anthem Jana Gana Mana as the best national anthem globally following an international cultural poll. UNESCO representatives have clarified on numerous occasions that the organization does not conduct national anthem competitions or evaluations.

title: Putting raw sliced onions in your socks overnight absorbs all toxins and cures viral fever
text: Social media wellness influencers claim placing sliced red onions against the soles of your feet inside socks overnight extracts systemic bloodstream toxins and cures seasonal influenza. Infectious disease physicians explain that onions do not absorb airborne pathogens through human skin and advise medically approved hydration and antipyretics.

title: World Health Organization mandates all countries must ban meat consumption and enforce vegetarianism
text: Sensational conspiracy articles claim the World Health Organization passed a binding global treaty requiring all United Nations member countries to outlaw beef and poultry consumption by 2030. The WHO clarified it publishes nutritional dietary guidelines but holds no legal jurisdiction to mandate dietary choices or outlaw food products in sovereign nations.

title: 5G cellular towers emit high-frequency microwave radiation causing mass sudden death of migratory birds
text: Viral video clips claim flock deaths of wild starlings were triggered by newly installed 5G telecommunication antennas. Wildlife conservation authorities and veterinary pathology autopsies proved the bird deaths were caused by severe atmospheric microburst storms and collision trauma, having no correlation with radio frequencies.

title: Secret code star hash zero six hash activates free unlimited 5G high speed internet on all phones
text: Viral short videos claim dialing the USSD code star hash zero six hash activates hidden high-bandwidth military satellites providing lifetime free mobile data. Telecommunication engineers clarified that the code simply displays the phone hardware IMEI International Mobile Equipment Identity number and does not modify network data tariffs.

title: Eating raw bitter gourd and garlic cloves completely reverses coronary heart blockages in 3 days
text: Viral WhatsApp forwards claim consuming crushed garlic and raw bitter gourd juice completely dissolves calcified coronary artery blockages without surgical angioplasty or stents. The American Heart Association cautions that acute arterial plaque cannot be reversed with dietary juices and that relying on folklore claims during cardiac distress is life-threatening.

title: Famous Hollywood actor Morgan Freeman tragically passed away this morning at his California home
text: A clickbait post featuring a Photoshopped breaking news banner alleged beloved actor Morgan Freeman died at age 87. Fact-checking organizations and official talent representatives confirmed the report is entirely fabricated and that the Oscar-winning actor is alive and actively filming upcoming productions.

title: Leaked documents reveal government will freeze bank accounts of citizens who post negative online reviews
text: Social media posts claim a secret digital regulation will automatically freeze savings accounts and cancel passports of individuals who leave critical comments regarding state policy. Ministry of Law officials debunked the viral post, affirming banking rights and constitutional protections remain governed by statutory legal due process.

title: International Criminal Court issues arrest warrants for senior military commanders over war crimes
text: The International Criminal Court at The Hague announced arrest warrants for senior military commanders, citing documented evidence of intentional attacks against civilian infrastructure and violations of the Geneva Conventions.

title: James Webb Space Telescope discovers earliest supermassive black hole at dawn of the universe
text: Astrophysicists utilizing deep infrared imaging on the James Webb Space Telescope detected an actively accreting supermassive black hole dating to just 470 million years after the Big Bang, challenging existing theories of primordial cosmic growth.

title: Reserve Bank of India expands regulatory sandbox for offline digital payments and retail CBDC
text: The Reserve Bank of India notified the fifth cohort of its regulatory sandbox, focusing on offline contactless retail central bank digital currency transactions in remote rural regions with limited cellular connectivity.

title: World Health Organization prequalifies first mpox diagnostic PCR test for emergency international deployment
text: The WHO granted emergency use listing to an automated real-time PCR diagnostic assay, significantly expanding rapid testing availability across central African diagnostic laboratories.

title: European Space Agency Euclid mission releases first full-color astronomical survey of the dark universe
text: ESA Euclid space telescope released its inaugural catalog of panoramic deep-space observations, mapping billions of galaxies across 10 billion light-years to probe the expansion rate and distribution of dark energy.

title: Department of Telecommunications establishes national cyber security command center against digital arrest scams
text: The Ministry of Communications in coordination with central investigative agencies inaugurated an automated 24/7 telecommunications monitoring center to block spoofed VoIP calls impersonating judicial officials.

title: Global atmospheric CO2 concentrations reach record high according to NOAA Mauna Loa observatory
text: Scientists at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration confirmed monthly average carbon dioxide levels peaked at 426.9 parts per million, driven by continued fossil fuel combustion and intense wildfire emissions.

title: CERN researchers achieve laser cooling of positronium atoms opening new tests of quantum electrodynamics
text: Physicists at the AEgIS collaboration at CERN successfully demonstrated the first laser cooling of exotic positronium atoms to near absolute zero, facilitating ultra-high-precision matter-antimatter symmetry comparisons.

title: Ministry of Statistics reports Indian manufacturing sector grew by 7.3 percent year on year
text: National statistical release data confirmed strong quarterly output growth in capital goods, infrastructure materials, and consumer durables, supported by resilient domestic corporate balance sheets.

title: International Monetary Fund sanctions 7 billion dollar extended fund facility for macroeconomic stabilization
text: The Executive Board of the IMF approved a comprehensive medium-term financing arrangement, requiring structural fiscal consolidation, energy tariff reforms, and enhanced foreign exchange reserve management.

title: NASA Perseverance rover samples sediment core containing organic molecules in Jezero crater ancient river delta
text: Planetary geologists analyzing Raman spectrometer data confirmed sedimentary mudstone cores collected by Perseverance contain aromatic organic compounds consistent with past habitable lacustrine environments.

title: G20 Leaders Summit adopts joint ministerial declaration on reforming multilateral development banks
text: Member states finalized consensus communiques outlining operational roadmaps to increase concessional climate financing and triple global renewable energy generation capacity by 2030.

title: National Medical Commission mandates biometric attendance and facial recognition in all medical colleges
text: Regulatory guidelines issued to state health universities require continuous monitoring of faculty and student attendance to maintain curriculum accreditation standards.

title: Cybersecurity authorities uncover state-sponsored cyber espionage campaign targeting critical water infrastructure
text: CISA and allied cyber defence agencies published an advisory detailing credential-stuffing intrusions into supervisory control and data acquisition SCADA industrial control devices.

title: Archaeologists discover submerged 7000 year old stone road beneath Mediterranean seafloor near Croatia
text: Underwater geophysical sonar mapping revealed a submerged paved roadway constructed by prehistoric Hvar culture connecting coastal mainland settlements to ancient Neolithic islands.

title: Bank of Japan raises short-term policy interest rate ending seventeen years of negative rates
text: The Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Committee voted to exit its yield curve control framework, pointing to rising base wages and stable corporate inflation expectations.

title: Indian Space Research Organisation successfully conducts flight testing of scramjet air-breathing engine
text: ISRO demonstrated supersonic combustion ramjet operation at Mach 6 velocity, validating advanced carbon-carbon thermal protection tiles and fuel injection mechanisms for hypersonic vehicles.

title: World Trade Organization approves waiver of intellectual property protections for diagnostics and therapeutics
text: Trade ministers reached compromise terms under the TRIPS agreement to allow developing economies to produce generic pharmaceutical inputs during recognized health emergencies.

title: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change publishes special report on ocean warming and cryosphere retreat
text: Scientific synthesis confirmed accelerated mass loss from Greenland and West Antarctic ice sheets, warning of compound coastal storm surge flooding affecting low-lying megacities.

title: Federal Aviation Administration mandates comprehensive titanium alloy inspections on commercial jet engines
text: Airworthiness directives issued following metallurgical laboratory tests required ultrasonic non-destructive scanning on high-pressure compressor turbine discs across airline fleets.

title: Securities and Exchange Board of India tightens derivative trading rules for retail index options
